reviews.text: A huge thank you to the Malvezzi Clinic, which promptly operated and treated my cat Basky in August. The staff was incredibly competent and always available! ❤️

Excellent welcome and assistance, and a very clean clinic.
They also explained everything very well.

The facility is poorly equipped, with no air conditioning despite the intense heat. The waiting room is very uncomfortable and stuffy for both people and animals. Poor organization and subpar service. The wait is ridiculous.
Thank you very much for your patience and special attention.
Amazing! Thank you for helping my cat. The second they had fecies tests results they called me to establish the treatment for the cat! Thank you
Kind and professional, excellent experience

One star because I don't want to implicate all the other workers.
I wasn't there; my partner and daughter told me everything, crying.
We brought our cat on Thursday the 18th, and he was taken care of by "Doctor" Alecchi. For her, our animals are an appointment and a source of income.
Our cat wasn't a puppet; he wouldn't let anyone touch him, and he became aggressive when he was approached by the doctor, but a professional must know how to proceed.
A sick 15-year-old cat was placed on the table and held down by force with gloves (rightfully so because she was scratching) for examination. The cat hissed, meowed, and struggled to breathe, but she didn't understand that the cat was in pain. They even covered her head (because this method calms cats), but not at that moment when she was having difficulty breathing. She wasn't able to understand that she had to stop, that the cat was dying. 😢🐱😢
With the illness she had, she could have died the next day, or a week, or a year later, because she was a warrior. She hadn't stopped eating, she was jumping on furniture, running to catch flies, she wasn't ready to die, and she should have died at home, not terrified and scared. Alecchi wasn't able to understand that she had to stop...
When I called to go and pick up the certificate, they advised me to speak to the "doctor." Even though I was convinced she was dead, I wanted to hear her, cling to her explanations to ease the guilt of having brought her there.
She didn't even let me sit down, and immediately went on to say how aggressive my cat was.
When I told her I needed to be more careful, gentle, and reassure her... she said; SHOULD I SING THE SONG?
That was the limit, her professionalism...and it should be reported, but I won't go on for the sake of my daughter, who doesn't want to talk or remember that terrible moment anymore, how her cat died. 🐱😢🐱
Truly experienced and professional people.
Excellent service. Professional and friendly veterinarians, both with clients and animals. They'll see you even without an appointment if something urgent happens that day. Highly recommended.
Extraordinary staff, we moved out of Milan, but we always come back to them even if it takes us more than an hour, but we are happy, they saved our Thor.
Very competent, helpful, empathetic veterinarians

I accompanied my daughter with her two cats.
I noticed courtesy, competence, and great availability.
Highly recommended.
Excellent service, professional and human!

Very serious, professional, and meticulous.
You can tell they love what they do! 👌 …

Impeccable!

Professional and available for any need, from the most trivial to the most emergency!

But above all, based on honesty.

Absolutely positive experience! We went to the Malvezzi Clinic at Corso Lodi 56 for our cat Delta and had a wonderful time. All the staff were kind, professional, and very attentive; they looked after us with great expertise and helpfulness. The clinic is modern, welcoming, and meticulously cared for.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a trustworthy vet: truly an excellent choice! 🐾
Super attentive and thorough visit

I know the clinic because I had an emergency, first with a consultation and then in person.
I immediately noticed kindness, clarity, and above all professionalism!!
The staff was also excellent!!
I highly recommend it!

The Malvezzi Veterinary Clinic is a benchmark in Milan. The staff is highly professional, friendly, and always available to listen to the needs of owners and their pets. The environment is welcoming and well-organized, with modern equipment that allows for precise diagnoses and treatments. I had a wonderful experience and noticed great attention to both the health of the animals and the well-being of the people who accompany them. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking professionalism, expertise, and compassion.

Thank you, thank you, to the Malvezzi Clinic and all its staff. I took my dog ​​with anemia and low white blood cells to the clinic, which recommended specific and specialized tests, which revealed that she had contracted leishmaniasis (following a summer vacation in the South a year earlier). It was a difficult and worsening situation, but the clinic and all the staff were able to propose the right treatment so that my dog ​​could overcome the critical phase and begin the phase of disease control. An elderly dog ​​with an almost sealed fate without the clinic's treatments. My thanks are from an owner and a dog who will be able to spend some time together. We are grateful, and I will continue to refer to this clinic for my dog's health needs. The staff is very knowledgeable and empathetic, and you can turn to this clinic for various health issues for your pet.

I've been going to them for 5 years and have always been very happy with the service. They respond promptly, both by phone and email. They're available for any situation and have reasonable prices. I even had my dog ​​spayed and it went very well.
Highly recommended, with a professionalism and humanity that is almost unheard of anymore.
Pay close attention to the furry ones!

I learned about this wonderful veterinary clinic through a dear friend of mine who has a dog.
The staff are highly qualified and passionate about our four-legged friends.
Dr. Malvezzi was able to provide me with detailed and effective advice on the most appropriate treatments for the well-being of our beloved four-legged friends.
The checkup was thorough and meticulous.
Thanks again to all the staff.

We took our dogs to this facility and had a truly excellent experience. The staff was competent, kind, and attentive, both to us and especially to our pets. The facility is modern, well-organized, and equipped with all the necessary facilities. Their passion for their work is evident. Highly recommended!

Excellent veterinary clinic on Corso Lodi.
Trained staff and a new, well-maintained location.
They are very good
Very affectionate staff with dogs and professionalism
Arrogant, conceited, and superficial young man. Worst vet visit ever.

Excellent clinic! The staff is helpful and knowledgeable, ready to answer any of our questions.
Professional!
They work with passion, and the results are evident!

The vet was unable to administer the medicine to the cat and it dripped from the scruff of the neck to the point where the cat licked it and started foaming at the mouth. Never again in my life will I go to this veterinary clinic.
The clinic is brand new, spotlessly clean, and has truly kind and friendly medical staff. If only there were clinics like this for us...

I'm giving it 4 stars because I've always heard good things about it, even though I've never been there. It's honest and, above all, kind, and not just a commercial vet. It's a shame it has limited hours and isn't an emergency room.

Unfortunately, they failed me, especially regarding my cat. They were only interested in expensive tests and lab tests; they offered zero intervention. The cat had tracheobronchitis, which caused terrible diarrhea with fresh blood. I was told in a phone conversation that cats can survive diarrhea for up to a month.
I went to a veterinarian, who, in addition to giving us a precise diagnosis, administered a cortisone injection and antibiotics (for a high fever that hadn't been detected previously), and gave us a full course of antibiotic pills—all for a ridiculous price. The result: the cat recovered after just two days.
I understand the expense, but the health of our little furry friends should come first!
So much professionalism!!
I'm happy with Dr. Manca, she takes care of my Maltese in a kind and professional way, thank you so much ❤️
Competent and kind staff. I would recommend them if your dog needs them. Thank you very much.

A sincere thank you to all the staff, and especially to Dr. Manca, on behalf of my mother and I, for supporting our Teta throughout her journey, from her first vaccination 16 years ago to the most difficult final moments... Always with great professionalism, kindness, and humanity.
Thank you for everything!!
The doctors are very careful in interacting with our friends, my dog ​​is a very fearful puppy, nevertheless they managed to give him a thorough examination
